name: SUNeVision MEGA IDC, Tseung Kwan O
notes: SUNeVision says MEGA IDC Phase Two is underway; full three-phase development described as 1.2 million sq ft GFA and over 180MW power capacity. District: Sai Kung (Tseung Kwan O Industrial Estate), CLP territory.

name: SUNeVision MEGA Plus, Tseung Kwan O
notes: Flagship DC on first TKO plot sold by HKSAR government for high-tier DC use; launched Oct 2017, LEED Gold, 474,000 sq ft GFA (44,036 sqm), 299 Wan Po Road. District: Sai Kung, CLP territory. Capacity MW not published on official page.

name: SUNeVision MEGA Gateway, Tsuen Wan
notes: 7th SUNeVision DC, opened March 2023 per DCD; ~15,000 cross-connects claim; ~20MW per aggregators (C for MW). District: Tsuen Wan, CLP territory.

name: SUNeVision MEGA-i, Chai Wan
notes: Most-connected carrier hotel on HK Island; 200+ telco carriers, PoPs of 9 submarine cables, iAIX, HKIX R&E network; hosts HKIS-1/HKIS-2 cable landing stations (infrastructure, not counted separately). District: Eastern (Chai Wan), HK Electric territory.

name: SUNeVision MEGA Two, Fo Tan
notes: Mainland Telco & Internet Gateway facility, 8-12 Wong Chuk Yeung Road, Fo Tan, Sha Tin (address from aggregator, C). Part of MEGA Campus with BEAM Plus Excellent grade. District: Sha Tin, CLP territory.

name: China Telecom Global TKO1, Tseung Kwan O
notes: Official CTG TKO1 page lists campus area 20,000 sq m, GFA 80,000 sq m, total IT power capacity above 100MW, Phase 1 above 10MW. District: Sai Kung (TKO Industrial Estate).

name: Global Switch Hong Kong, Tseung Kwan O
notes: Global Switch HK campus at 18 Chun Yat Street, TKO Industrial Estate (address from aggregator, C); 30MW available, 70,545 sq m, 100MVA utility power; China Telecom announced as anchor with HK$5bn (US$640m) investment context. District: Sai Kung.

name: NTT Financial Data Center (FDC) campus, Tseung Kwan O
notes: FDC1 launched 2013; FDC2 opened Dec 2015 with 7,000+ racks (Tier IV ready per IndoTelko); NTT page states FDC and Tai Po DC together provide 10,000+ racks. District: Sai Kung (TKO Industrial Estate). Capacity MW not published.

name: NTT Tai Po Data Centre (TPDC)
notes: NTT's Tai Po DC in Tai Po Industrial Estate; one aggregator lists address as Apt Telepark, 2 Dai Hei Street (C, unconfirmed). District: Tai Po, CLP territory.

name: HKEX New Generation Data Centre (NGDC), Tseung Kwan O
notes: Tier IV NGDC at TKO Industrial Estate per JRP project page; HKEX offers low-latency colocation hosting at the site. District: Sai Kung. B for project; A for HKEX ownership via filings.

name: China Mobile International Global Network Center / China Mobile HK DC
notes: CMI GNC at 3 Chun Cheong Street, TKO Industrial Estate serves as global telecom hub, cable landing station, GNOC and IDC; ~22MW per aggregator (C). SEA-H2X cable from TKO gazetted 2025-26 (A for gazette, infrastructure not facility). District: Sai Kung.

name: China Unicom (Hong Kong) Global Center, Tseung Kwan O
notes: Opened Aug 2016; HK$3bn investment; China Unicom's first and largest facility outside mainland China at the time; 19 Chun Wang Street, TKO Industrial Estate (address from aggregator, C); ATAL/JRP MEP projects. District: Sai Kung.

name: Telehouse Hong Kong CCC (Cloud Computing Complex), Tseung Kwan O
notes: First HK data center with TIA-942 Rated 4 certification; 2 Chun Yat Street, TKO; since 2011; SJC submarine cable accessible in-facility. District: Sai Kung.

name: Telehouse Hong Kong (THHK)
notes: Telehouse's first Greater China data centre (since 2000); TIA Rated 4 claim on THHK CCC page; address not published on page - verify separately.

name: HKT SkyExchange TKO (TKO2/TKO3), Tseung Kwan O
notes: HKT SkyExchange TKO2 site code at 22 Chun Cheong Street; TKO3 at 2 Chun Yat Street per aggregators (C); HKT's AI Data Centre Interconnect superhighway (Lok Ma Chau-TKO, 2026) is connectivity infrastructure, not a facility. District: Sai Kung.

name: Towngas Telecom TGT DC 2, Tseung Kwan O
notes: 5-storey, 22,000 sq m standalone DC at 22 Chun Cheong Street, TKO Industrial Estate supporting ~3,300 high-density racks (aggregator sources, C). District: Sai Kung.

name: Equinix HK5, Tseung Kwan O
notes: Equinix lists HK5 among its six HK IBX sites (A for listing); aggregators place it at 299 Wan Po Road, TKO Industrial Estate (C, address unconfirmed on Equinix page). District: Sai Kung.

name: Equinix HK1, Tsuen Wan (Goodman Global Gateway)
notes: HK1 at Goodman Global Gateway, 168 Yeung Uk Road, Tsuen Wan; liquid-cooling-capable; fibre paths to HK2/HK3/HK5. District: Tsuen Wan, CLP territory.

name: Equinix HK2, Kwai Chung
notes: Equinix HK2 in the Tsuen Wan area per Equinix; aggregators give 7/F Kerry Warehouse, 3 Shing Yiu Street, Kwai Chung (C for address); liquid-cooling-capable. District: Kwai Tsing/Tsuen Wan boundary, CLP territory.

name: Equinix HK3, Tsuen Wan
notes: Equinix lists HK3 among its HK IBX sites (A for listing); aggregator address 1 Wang Wo Tsai Street, Tsuen Wan (C). District: Tsuen Wan.

name: Equinix HK4, Tsuen Wan area
notes: Equinix lists HK4 as one of six HK data centers (A for listing only); street address not published on the metro page - unverified. District: Tsuen Wan area.

name: Equinix HK6, Tsuen Wan
notes: Launched June 2026; US$124m investment; phase 1 provides 1,000 cabinets (Q1 2026) with 3,550 at full build-out over 41,600 sq ft; address 18 Sha Tsui Road, Tsuen Wan (from aggregator, C). District: Tsuen Wan.

name: Vantage Kwai Chung HKG3
notes: 16-floor Kwai Chung facility, 14MW critical IT load per methodology/Vantage; CLP power; Tier III and LEED Platinum claims; aggregator address Cargo Consolidation Complex, 43 Container Port Road (C). District: Kwai Tsing.

name: Vantage Tsuen Wan West HKG5
notes: Vantage project datasheet gives 48MW critical IT load and 700,000 sq ft for Tsuen Wan West DC; later databases still list as planned/developing. District: Tsuen Wan.

name: Digital Realty HKG10, Tseung Kwan O
notes: Digital Realty lists HKG10 with 200,000 sq ft (18,581 sq m) colocation space; methodology-verified address 33 Chun Choi Street, Tseung Kwan O; one aggregator lists 11 Chun Kwong Street (discrepancy - confirm on operator page). District: Sai Kung.

name: Digital Realty HKG11, Kwai Chung
notes: Digital Realty lists HKG11 at 11 Kin Chuen Street, Kwai Chung, 228,000 sq ft (21,182 sq m); DCD covered construction start. District: Kwai Tsing.

name: CITIC Telecom Tower Data Centre (DataHOUSE @ CTT), Kwai Chung
notes: CTT Data Centre on CITIC Telecom's own property floors of 26-storey CITIC Telecom Tower, 93 Kwai Fuk Road, Kwai Chung (~300,000 sq ft GFA); DataHOUSE brand (C until CITIC confirms via HKEX filing 1883). District: Kwai Tsing.

name: ixTech Data Centre, Kwai Chung
notes: Carrier-neutral DC at Ever Gain Plaza Tower 2, 88 Container Port Road, Kwai Chung (7/F per ASN whois, C). District: Kwai Tsing.

name: AirTrunk HKG1, Tsing Yi/Tsuen Wan area
notes: AirTrunk official page: total capacity above 20MW, 17,400 sq m GFA, 8,000+ sq m technical space; opened Dec 2020; Microsoft anchor; CLP REC deal Nov 2022; aggregator address 22-28 Cheung Tat Road (C). District: Kwai Tsing/Tsuen Wan boundary.

name: AirTrunk HKG2, East New Territories
notes: Scalable to over 15MW; initial capacity delivered mid-2024; retrofit of existing building, 4,400 sqm technical space; aggregator address 9-11 Shing Wan Road (C). HKG1+HKG2 total 35+MW per AirTrunk. District: East NT (TBD).

name: ESR Kwai Chung Data Centre HK1
notes: ESR secured HK$1.6bn sustainability-linked loan to convert a Kwai Chung building into 21.3MW ESR Kwai Chung Data Centre HK1; Baxtel indicates build/expansion activity through 2027. District: Kwai Tsing.

name: GDS HK1, Kwai Chung
notes: GDS's first self-built HK DC, fully moved in by customers; 18.8MW total IT power, ~22,931 sq m floor area; one of the tallest purpose-built DCs in Asia. District: Kwai Tsing/Kwai Chung.

name: Goodman Tsuen Wan West Data Centre campus (incl. Building 3 for GDS)
notes: Goodman completed and handed over Building 3 (50MW) to GDS Oct 2024; campus is 225MW total. District: Tsuen Wan (Tsuen Wan West).

name: Goodman Texaco Centre Data Centre, Tsuen Wan
notes: Goodman 126-140 Texaco Road Tsuen Wan conversion, ~50MW (32MW per one source), groundbroken 2024, due 2026; Goodman's 8th HK DC project; 14 floors (Baxtel). District: Tsuen Wan.

name: Cyberport AI Supercomputing Centre (AISC), Pok Fu Lam
developer: Cyberport / Hong Kong government (HK$3bn AI scheme)
notes: Phase 1 operations commenced Dec 2024 (1,300 PFLOPS claimed, NVIDIA H800); target 3,000 PFLOPS; HK's largest supercomputing facility. District: Southern (Cyberport, Pok Fu Lam), HK Electric territory. Capacity MW not published.

name: OneAsia Data Centre, Chai Wan (OneAs1a)
notes: OneAsia operates HK DC presence (Chai Wan per Baxtel; Kowloon Bay mentioned on official connectivity page); adopting Submer immersion cooling per DCD. District: Eastern (Chai Wan) / Kwun Tong (Kowloon Bay) - verify.

name: Sandy Ridge Data Facility Cluster (Range HK), North District

notes: Awarded 2 Mar 2026 on 50-year land grant (premium HK$581m) to Hong Kong Range Intelligent Computing Technology; site >110,000 sq m; HK$23.8bn investment commitment; groundbreaking 28 Mar 2026; operation expected in ~42 months; up to 180 ExaFLOPS target. Land grant + construction - not yet operational. District: North (Sandy Ridge, east of Lo Wu), Northern Metropolis.

name: Mapletree Fanling Data Centre
notes: Mapletree's first Hong Kong data centre at Fanling, completion year 2026, up to 50MVA building power (capacity_mw null because source states MVA not MW). District: North (Fanling).

notes: HKBN operates data centres at San Po Kong and TKO Industrial Estate with dual fibre pathways (HKBN + Towngas Telecom fibre); aggregator-grade evidence, addresses unverified. Districts: Wong Tai Sin (San Po Kong) + Sai Kung (TKO).

name: OneAsia Kowloon Bay data centre
notes: OneAsia official connectivity page lists Kowloon Bay among its HK data centre locations (C; address unverified). District: Kwun Tong (Kowloon Bay).

developer: China Telecom / Daily Tech / Global Switch
notes: Baxtel Oct 2024: China Telecom and Daily Tech partnered with Global Switch on HK$5bn (US$640m) TKO Industrial Estate DC, 71,000 sq m, adjacent to TKO cable landing station; may overlap with Global Switch HK campus record - dedupe by address. District: Sai Kung.
